# FutureUp Academy

> Azerbaijan's #1 IT academy — practical IT courses in Baku for kids and adults: programming, web development, data analytics, AI, cybersecurity and digital marketing. On-site and online, with certificates and career support. Content available in Azerbaijani (default), Russian and English.

FutureUp Academy (futureup.az) trains students in Baku, Azerbaijan across two audiences: adults (career-focused IT programs) and kids/teens aged 8–16 (coding, AI, cybersecurity). Courses show transparent pricing in AZN, duration, a module-by-module curriculum, and a per-course FAQ.
